channel.title: GodotAwesome
channel.description: Your place for Godot Engine content: tutorials, projects, and community insights for indie developers and open-source creators.

item.title: Godot Versions: Release Dates, Support Status and What Changed
item.description: Every Godot 4 release with dates and support status. Latest stable is 4.7.2, 4.8 is in beta. What each version added and which one to use.

item.title: Godot 4.7 Features: AreaLight3D, HDR Output and the New Asset Store
item.description: What Godot 4.7 added: AreaLight3D, HDR output, the new Asset Store, VirtualJoystick, Android XR support and more. Highlights and upgrade notes.

item.title: Godot 4.6 to 4.7 Migration Guide: Breaking Changes and Fixes
item.description: Upgrading a project from Godot 4.6 to 4.7? The breaking changes, behavior changes and changed defaults, with a checklist and the fixes you need.

item.title: Write for GodotAwesome: How to Submit a Guest Article
item.description: Want to write about Godot? Here is how to pitch and submit a guest article to GodotAwesome with a GitHub pull request, plus our writing rules.

item.title: Godot 4.8 Beta: What's New and What Breaks
item.description: Godot 4.8 beta 1 is out: new editor docks, Trail3D, rendering upgrades, a .NET 10 requirement and breaking changes. What to know before you test or upgrade.

item.title: Godot MCP Setup with Claude Code: Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
item.description: Connect Claude Code to Godot with an MCP server in about 5 minutes. Exact commands for Windows, macOS and Linux, how to verify it, and how to fix common errors.

item.title: Ship a Godot iOS Game From an Android Phone (No Mac, No Laptop)
item.description: Build a Godot game for iOS and upload it to TestFlight using only an Android phone: Termux, the Godot Android editor and the ShipThis CLI.

item.title: Liquid Glass Icons for Godot iOS Games (iOS 26+ App Icon Guide)
item.description: How to add a Liquid Glass app icon to a Godot iOS game for iOS 26: what a .icon file is, making one in Icon Composer, and adding it to the exported Xcode project.

item.title: Games Made with Godot in 2026: Steam Hits Over 1,000 Peak Players
item.description: Games made with Godot in 2026 that passed 1,000 peak concurrent players on Steam. Machine Party, Road to Vostok, Hearth and Hamlet, and a full tracker list.

item.title: Slay the Spire 2 on Godot: Millions of Players After the Unity Switch
item.description: Slay the Spire 2 Godot success story: Mega Crit left Unity for Godot, then hit millions of players in Early Access. Sales estimates, reviews, and what developers can learn.
